# Mansi Dhruv

> Lead Data Engineer & Solution Architect with 7+ years of production experience building cloud lakehouses, distributed data engines, and GPU-accelerated pipelines across AWS, Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, and Apache Iceberg.

## Core Identity & Philosophy
- **Role**: Lead Data Engineer & Solution Architect
- **Principle**: Complexity -> Operability ("I build reliable data platforms — from raw inputs to decisions teams can trust.")

## Upstream Open Source Contributions
- **NVIDIA/cudf-spark**: GPU-accelerated Apache Spark SQL execution (`GpuCreateDataSourceTableAsSelectCommand` overwrite semantics, `TaskContext` pre-completion listeners, `GpuTaskMetrics` retention, driverless broadcast metric assertions, Spark Catalyst versioning).
- **apache/iceberg-python**: Snapshot ID invariant validation during branch snapshot expiration (`#4265`).
- **delta-io/delta-rs**: Tuple filter support in Python write, update, and delete predicates (`#5028`).
- **databricks/dbt-databricks**: `delta.dataSkippingStatsColumns` for snapshot tables (`#1767`), environment variable query tags (`#1766`), Unity Catalog relation literal escaping (`#1758`).
- **ibis-project/ibis**: PostgreSQL read-only schema inspection (`#12214`), Decimal mean type promotion & precision/scale (`#12211`).

## Flagship Systems & Tooling
- **Sentinel Lakehouse** (`https://github.com/MsMansiDhruv/sentinel-lakehouse`): Production Medallion Lakehouse on Databricks with Auto Loader, Delta CDF, SCD1/SCD2, Great Expectations quarantine gates, offline `sqlglot` AST evaluation (~85ms CI), and AutoHeal-DE partition recovery.
- **dlt-doctor** (`https://github.com/MsMansiDhruv/dlt-doctor`, PyPI: `pip install dlt-doctor`): Static AST optimizer, diagnostic engine, and built-in Model Context Protocol (MCP) stdio server (`dlt-doctor mcp`) for Databricks Delta Live Tables and PySpark Catalyst plans.
- **GQuery Relational Engine** (`https://github.com/MsMansiDhruv/gquery-engine-clone`): In-memory vectorized columnar query execution engine (`ColumnVector`, `RecordBatch`, bitmask filtering, rule-based predicate pushdown).

## Measured Production Impact
- **Streaming Latency**: -40% end-to-end latency reduction (Databricks DLT + Kafka/Kinesis).
- **Compute Cost**: -30% DBU reduction via workload separation and auto-scaling.
- **Storage I/O**: -24% bytes scanned via Delta Lake Liquid Clustering.
- **Memory & Shuffle**: Eliminated 100GB+ disk spills via AQE dynamic skew splitting.
- **CI/CD SQL Evaluation**: Reduced eval latency from ~150s cluster runs to ~85ms offline AST verification.
